set -eu
userbase="$PWD/.caper-userbase"
export PYTHONUSERBASE="$userbase"
python3 -m pip install --user --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-cache-dir "caper==2.2.3" "miniwdl==0.7.0" "autouri==0.2.4" "pyhocon==0.3.63" "humanfriendly==9.1" "pyopenssl==19.1.0" "cryptography==3.3.2" "protobuf==3.19.6"
export PATH="$userbase/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$userbase/lib/python3.6/site-packages"
cat > hello.wdl <<'WDL'
version 1.0
workflow hello {
  call hi
  output {
    File out = hi.out
  }
}
task hi {
  command {
    echo hello > out.txt
  }
  output {
    File out = "out.txt"
  }
}
WDL
echo '{}' > hello.json
dry_status=0
"$userbase/bin/caper" run   --backend local   --ignore-womtool   --dry-run   --local-out-dir "$PWD/smoke-out"   --local-loc-dir "$PWD/smoke-loc"   --max-concurrent-tasks 1   --disable-call-caching   --str-label encode_atac_cromwell_smoke   -i "$PWD/hello.json"   "$PWD/hello.wdl" > dry.log 2>&1 || dry_status=$?
find "$PWD/smoke-loc" -type f -name backend.conf -print -quit > backend.path
find "$PWD/smoke-loc" -type f -name workflow_opts.json -print -quit > options.path
find "$PWD/smoke-loc" -type f -name labels.json -print -quit > labels.path
find "$PWD/smoke-loc" -type f -name hello.wdl -print -quit > wdl.path
backend=
options=
labels=
wdl=
if IFS= read -r backend < backend.path; then :; else true; fi
if IFS= read -r options < options.path; then :; else true; fi
if IFS= read -r labels < labels.path; then :; else true; fi
if IFS= read -r wdl < wdl.path; then :; else true; fi
jar="$PWD/cromwell-82.jar"
wget -q -O "$jar" https://github.com/broadinstitute/cromwell/releases/download/82/cromwell-82.jar
direct_status=0
if test -n "$backend" && test -n "$wdl"; then
  java -Xmx1G -XX:ParallelGCThreads=1 -DLOG_LEVEL=INFO -DLOG_MODE=standard "-Dconfig.file=$backend" -jar "$jar" run "$wdl" -i "$PWD/hello.json" -m "$PWD/metadata.json" > direct.log 2>&1 || direct_status=$?
else
  direct_status=99
fi
{
  echo DRY_STATUS
  echo "$dry_status"
  echo DIRECT_STATUS
  echo "$direct_status"
  echo DRY_LOG
  cat dry.log
  echo DIRECT_LOG
  cat direct.log
  echo PATHS
  cat backend.path options.path labels.path wdl.path
  echo OUTPUTS
  if test -d "$PWD/smoke-out"; then find "$PWD/smoke-out" -type f -maxdepth 8 -print; fi
} > dryrun-evidence.txt
test -s dryrun-evidence.txt
